sub_site: serum (cirrhosis patients with/without ascites and healthy controls); ascitic fluid also profiled (not extracted)

evidence.quote: We analyzed the microbiome of samples from healthy controls (stool, n = 17; serum, n = 7) and cirrhotic patients (stool, n = 27; serum, n = 27; ascitic fluid, n = 11)
the hyper-variable region (V4) of the bacterial and archaeal 16 S rRNA gene was amplified by PCR
together with negative controls from the extraction and PCR methods, were analyzed with QIIME 1.8.0
negative controls added during the extraction (NEG1 and NEG2) and PCR (NEG3) procedures
OTUs detected in negative controls were also removed for downstream analyses

notes: No serum genus named in text after filtering (only 'unknown genus related to Cyanobacteria', Clostridiales family, Moraxellaceae); genus names in E0008/E0009 are stool only. Pseudomonas and Halomonas were the dominant genera in blanks and were subtracted from serum/ascites data; recorded as flagged contaminants (uncertain whether detected in serum). Gel-band intensity only (no qPCR). Healthy serum yielded no sequence data after filtering. No supplements available.
